```yaml
name: macOS ARM PyInstaller

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-macos-arm:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
        run: |
          brew update
          # Add any Homebrew packages required by pyinstaller.sh
          brew install pyqt5
          # If other dependencies are needed, add them here

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Make pyinstaller.sh executable
        run: chmod +x pyinstaller.sh

      - name: Run pyinstaller.sh
        run: ./pyinstaller.sh

      - name: Create compressed app bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          tar -czf dist/SSHPilot.app.tar.gz -C dist SSHPilot.app

      - name: Compute DMG checksum
        run: |
          shasum -a 256 dist/SSHPilot.dmg > dist/SSHPilot.dmg.sha256

      - name: Upload DMG artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SSHPilot.dmg
          path: dist/SSHPilot.dmg

      - name: Upload compressed app bundle artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SSHPilot.app.tar.gz
          path: dist/SSHPilot.app.tar.gz

      - name: Upload checksum artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: checksum
          path: dist/SSHPilot.dmg.sha256
```
